description:
delivered_env (src/ir_interp/backend.rs:1999, clones at :2056/:2059) and capture_backend_continuation_env (:2304, clones at :2323/:2332) take &HashMap and clone each capture into a fresh env; nearly every caller owns the old env and drops it right after.
Callers passing a dying env: :315, :459, :861, :1138, :1359, :1420, :1448, :1462, :2246; capture_backend_continuation_env at :1334, :2124. eval_direct_call (:2102) takes env by value and only borrows it.
Not removable: Try at :1487/:1494, where handler frame and body both read the same env; that caller keeps a visible clone.
Before building: establish whether a ValueId can appear in both captures and physical_captures of one entry. If it can, the move must account for it.
Shape: the helpers take the env by value and remove each capture.
Heat: once per entry transition in the interpreter main loop (run_backend_resume, :747), at program run time.

Method: .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md. Change the signature and let cargo check enumerate dependents; resolve interleavings by compute-then-commit or a split borrow; stop and report if an Rc is the only move.
Signal: pure refactor. Full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves. Report the clone/to_vec count of each touched file before and after.
Sites were read at develop 8bf8775ae and not compiled; confirm each with cargo check before relying on it.
title: A control transition moves captures out of the env it is leaving
